This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER

This is the second bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.156 of 2023 registered at Police Station - Gorakhpur, District-Jabalpur (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n),
376(D), 506 of the Indian Penal Code, Section 3/4, 5(l)/6, 5(g)/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 and Sections 3(1)(W)(i), 3(1)(W)(ii), 3(2)(v) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989.

sentences.text: Applicant is in detention since 06.03.2023.
2. As per the prosecution story, it is alleged that the applicant and other co-accused persons committed gang rape with the minor prosecutrix.
On the basis of aforesaid allegations, police registered case against the applicant and co-accused person under aforesaid section.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that there are many contradictions and improvements in the statements of the prosecutrix and her maternal uncle which create doubt on the prosecution story.
DNA report regarding present applicant is found negative.
The applicant is in custody since 06.03.2023.
It is further submitted that the trial of the case will take considerable time.

sentences.text: has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail pending the trial.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for State as well as learned counsel for the objector have opposed the grant of bail to the applicant.
They submitted that on material point of time there is no contradictions.

In all the statements, prosecutrix has stated that applicant and co-accused persons have committed gang rape with her by mixing some intoxicant substance in the coffee of the prosecutrix, as a result of which, she fell unconscious and thereafter, the applicant and other co-accused persons have taken undue advantages of her.
It is also submitted that prosecutrix is minor.
Thus, prays for rejection of bail application.
5. Looking to the age of the prosecutrix and seriousness of offence, I am not inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands dismissed.

(PRAMOD KUMAR AGRAWAL) JUDGE julie Jittu Urf Jitendra Valmik vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148286046/
